namedGate: Combined proposal/illustrated narrative-board review; text passes remain scoped

findings.title: E01 offered card and ambiguous alternatives

artifacts.location: Upper-right: ed still holds card; lower-right: bob faces camera while sam walks to doorway

findings.effect: Passing the desk may be mistaken for recovered custody; adjacent exclusive outcomes appear sequential.
findings.smallestCorrection: Show completed receipt versus visible empty holder, align departure, label the two alternatives.
findings.responsibleRole: Visual Artist with Scene Director, only on Producer assignment
findings.recheckEvidence: New hashed full board and supplied small view: recipient holds card in return branch; temporary-admission branch retains absence and visibly separate chronology.

findings.title: E02 clear hand is not established

artifacts.location: Large-left carrier/clamp and sam hand; upper-right departure

findings.effect: The shared cue cannot be read as an actionable condition; viewers cannot distinguish a controlled start from premature operation.
findings.smallestCorrection: Choose an explicit clear-hand-before-start state or short sequence; preserve wash destination and company cost.
findings.recheckEvidence: New board shows hand outside carrier/clamp area before control operation; eventual motion/contact gate remains separate.

findings.title: E03 swapped outcome still shows paperwork

artifacts.location: Lower-right: STILETTO foreground paperwork, LIMEN paperwork inside

findings.effect: Swapping supervisors reads as relocation, not easier admission meeting limited receiving space.
findings.smallestCorrection: Show actual passage past STILETTO and an occupied receiving area/held next carrier under LIMEN; label native versus swapped futures.
findings.responsibleRole: Visual Artist / Scene Director with Systems conditions
findings.recheckEvidence: New hashed board makes passage and the new downstream constraint visible without explanatory author rationale; no claimed throughput numbers.

findings.title: E04 changes control geography and misses release

artifacts.location: Large-left bob control at right; upper-right sam control at left; lower-right kit hand over carrier

findings.effect: The reciprocal turn looks like a different workstation; the later callback does not show the condition the words require.
findings.smallestCorrection: Keep one identifiable control and axis, show actual hand withdrawal before start, distinguish unpowered rehearsal from powered work.
findings.recheckEvidence: New hashed panels preserve prop identity, specify each moment and show release/start order; later performance inspection still required.

findings.title: Specific identity drift across boards

artifacts.location: Large-left bob eye emphasis; lower-right STILETTO silhouette
Projecting toothed jaw and swept head

findings.effect: Recognizing a known person across scenes becomes less reliable; STILETTO loses a defining equipment cue.
findings.smallestCorrection: Restore the cited head/equipment cues in the same causal-board revision. No new identity or generic palette change.
findings.recheckEvidence: Compare new full and small panels with cited approved references. Perspective alone does not establish scale failure.
findings.origin: STILETTO and ed in first pass; bob eye concern sharpened by later author notes and compared with already viewed image/reference.

findings.title: Fine actions and branch distinctions disappear at 320×180
findings.effect: Preview silhouettes cannot establish custody, safe hand clearance or mutually exclusive futures.
findings.smallestCorrection: Supply legible adjacent branch captions and full-view access or focused causal crops; reduce only local clutter where it hides the action.
findings.responsibleRole: Visual Artist / Scene Director; Engine later delivery integration
findings.recheckEvidence: Inspect the actual next delivered previews with their captions and full-view context; do not equate static legibility with motion acceptance.

findings.title: E01 authority selection needs an explicit decision table
findings.effect: The reviewed brief does not yet let a reviewer determine every available action or why a button is absent. This is not a demonstrated runtime bug.
findings.smallestCorrection: Add only a condition/actor/action/visible-reason table; retain custody versus admission separation and automatic adviser decisions.
findings.responsibleRole: Systems designer through Producer; Engine later verifies implementation
findings.recheckEvidence: Concrete table reconciles return, hold, authorized temporary passage, no authority and earlier recovery; later matched runtime traces required.

findings.title: E03 closes by repeating the dependency
findings.effect: The practical gus question and supervisor answer have landed before the final paraphrase; the ending loses momentum.
findings.smallestCorrection: First test ending at C12. If retaining the proposed alternative C13, establish a genuinely new demand and response. Do not rewrite the whole argument.
findings.recheckEvidence: New exact speech IDs/text plus later normal-speed read or staging. Preserve gus question and native motives; author alternative is not accepted here.

findings.title: Defer broader Theatre programme in first proof
findings.effect: Additional sessions have stated cost but no equally concrete distinct witnessed benefit yet; they enlarge the first proof without improving its clear kit payoff.
findings.smallestCorrection: Prototype bounded reciprocal demonstration and eligible kit callback first; retain broader scope as an owner decision.
findings.recheckEvidence: Owner scope decision; if broader option is retained, demonstrate its distinct observed benefit, time cost and authorized attendance.

findings.title: Proposed contracts have no play evidence
findings.effect: Text cannot prove actual hearing, reading holds, custody, invitation availability, capacity, saves or two-week tempo.
findings.smallestCorrection: Keep these gates explicitly open; later use matched conditional examples including earlier recovery, all-dispatch, absent listener and offscreen transfer.
findings.responsibleRole: Engine Master / Systems / Scene Director under Producer
findings.recheckEvidence: Runtime evidence for exact conditions; completed-day timing and comprehension. No performance acceptance from this review.

findings.title: Gus and kit samples are too short for broad voice acceptance
findings.effect: Useful plain lines establish local action, not full distinct voice range or delivery quality.
findings.smallestCorrection: Preserve the functional lines; judge fuller warranted samples when available, without adding decorative dialogue.
findings.recheckEvidence: Actual additional justified exchange and performed evidence; no invented blind-test or audio pass.

findings.title: Narrow promotion patch is suitable text, not integrated evidence

artifacts.location: Two-document changes to EDITORIAL_VOICE and TARANTINO_CASE_STUDY

findings.effect: Owner guidance and current chronology are accurately carried by the proposed edits, but reading a patch does not prove integration or exact reconstruction.
findings.smallestCorrection: Carry the narrow patch to assigned Engine integration checks; keep old staging historical and canon unchanged until authorized.
findings.recheckEvidence: Exact resulting document hashes and patch applicability/reconstruction evidence on the assigned source; no blanket dialogue rewrite.

justifiedPasses.reason: Limited help, specific petty authority/humour, card return without automatic forgiveness.
Specific material curiosity becomes reciprocal attention; staffing costs company without manufactured harm.
CATHEXIS makes a useful concession; promise breach is conditional; kit actual hand condition changes the start.
Distinct costs, next actual LIMEN check, variable readiness and actual attendance protect causal continuity and allow relief.
